rule: The only per-Challenge input to the ledger generator: pointers to artefacts, never values. Adding a Challenge is one entry here; the generator reads everything else from the artefacts.
measurements_note: UNMEASURED fields are measurements, not owner questions: each names the owner who measures it and the tool or PR that does. PR states are as of 2026-10-10 (verified with gh pr view); cite by number if unmerged.

packet.tool: A design packet following COMMON_DESIGN_PACKET_V1 for this Challenge (docs/development/challenge_pipeline/COMMON_DESIGN_PACKET_V1.md)

packet_sections.tool: The packet re-issued on COMMON_DESIGN_PACKET_V1 sections, or a section map for this packet

input_time_to_obtain.tool: None yet: record the date each input is obtained in cycle_metrics.jsonl (recorder A9 in ONBOARDING_PIPELINE.md)

dated_stage_records.tool: cycle_metrics.jsonl, hand-recorded until the A9 recorder exists

cost_per_stage.tool: Stage report: each run's cap fraction; spend ledgers stay out of the repository

grant_caps.tool: A stage grant file under docs/development/graphite/grants once approved

speed_up.tool: Data Collection reference timing (value-cost C1) plus the model inference cost, on the same hardware

cheap_baseline_v4.tool: Data Collection panels, PR 994 (CHEAP-BASELINE-COMPARATORS-01, open) and the evaluator PR 1003 (PASSES-VALUE-EVALUATOR-01, open)

network_leaderboard.tool: Validator-scored Launchpad confirmations from stage A

network_agents_vs_miners.tool: Validator-scored Launchpad confirmations from Graphite agents and from real miners on the same Challenge

value_a.tool: The Challenge packet's engineering-job section and the buyer-volume evidence (PR 939, merged)

value_b.tool: Data Collection panels, PR 994 comparators (open) and the evaluator PR 1003 (open)

value_c.tool: Data Collection reference timing plus the model inference cost, on the same hardware

value_d.tool: The Challenge packet and the buyer-volume evidence (PR 939, merged)

value_e.tool: PR 998 (EQUAL-BUDGET-DESIGN-01, open) on the design_search track_b harness

code_verification.tool: None yet: a Method of Manufactured Solutions test, or an exact analytic-solution test where MMS is not practical, per pinned image; re-run on any rebuild or re-pin

solution_verification.tool: Refinement and conservation checks on the pinned package (value-cost T5, reference adequacy)

validation.tool: Benchmark comparisons for the pinned package, recorded beside the other two layers
